title: The commit receipt never arrives
description: The provider applied the change but the commit receipt or completion event never arrives; the action stays UNKNOWN until reconciliation and is never reported RESOLVED without a receipt.
callerVisible: The caller hears the change is being confirmed; success is spoken only after a reconciled receipt.
backendEvidence: No RESOLVED outcome without a receipt
notes: Added to the fixed fault registry for the follow-on prompt section 17 fault matrix. The LOCAL FIXTURE driver does not inject it (NOT_SUPPORTED); only the Layer-2 run tagged [FAULT:RECEIPT_LOST] owned by WP-25 proves it.

registry.injectionPoint: the commit receipt or completion event never arrives

postconditions: The action stays UNKNOWN until an authoritative receipt is reconciled
RESOLVED is never recorded from case creation or workflow acceptance (ACT-04)
